findings.observation: The remote A-button fallback runs before TrySetupDiveDownScript, so an adjacent visible remote can consume A before the dive action is evaluated.
findings.impact: A remote can prevent a valid local dive-down field action.
findings.recommendation: Move remote interaction after all local A-triggered actions including Dive and add a dive-overlap regression.
